<!--
  TidyTuesday 2026-10-24: DuBois Circle
  Spiral chart drawn in the manner of W.E.B. Du Bois.

  Structure
    1. Setup:   load data, validate, prepare the six rings
    2. Layout:  SVG filter, CSS, opening of the page container
    3. Chart:   build rings, hatching strokes, labels, plot
    4. Closing: footer and end of the page container
-->

<!-- ===== 1. Setup ===== -->

```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(showtext)
library(showtextdb)
library(sysfonts)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev.args = list(bg = "#faf9f6"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Load data (original values from W.E.B. Du Bois, 1900)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
du_bois <- read_csv("du_bois_circle_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  rename(jahr = Year, wert = `Houshold Value (Dollars)`)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare the six years as rings (largest value = ring 1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
daten_fuer_spirale <- du_bois |>
  arrange(desc(wert)) |>
  mutate(
    family = as.character(jahr),   # column name kept, the ring function expects it
    ring = row_number(),
    winkel_grad = wert / max(wert) * 668,
    start_rad = pi / 2,
    end_rad = (pi / 2) - (winkel_grad * pi / 180)
  )
```

<!-- ===== 3. Chart ===== -->

```{r spirale}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5.9
#| fig-dpi: 200
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: 100%

font_add_google("Cutive Mono", "cutive_mono")
showtext_auto()

# ===============================================================
# A. Ring geometry
# ===============================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# A1. Base parameters and growth rate (k) derived from ring 1
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
dicke <- 0.12
r_start_1 <- 2.5
r_end_1 <- 1.3

ring_1 <- daten_fuer_spirale |> filter(ring == 1)
delta_1_rad <- ring_1$winkel_grad * (pi / 180)
k <- (r_start_1 - r_end_1) / delta_1_rad

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# A1b. Ring angles: arc length (not angle) is proportional to value
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
bogenlaenge <- function(a, delta) {
  integrate(function(t) sqrt((a - k * t)^2 + k^2), 0, delta)$value
}

a_mitte <- r_start_1 + (daten_fuer_spirale$ring - 1) * dicke + dicke / 2
L_ring1 <- bogenlaenge(a_mitte[1], delta_1_rad)

delta_neu <- map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(daten_fuer_spirale)), function(i) {
  if (i == 1) return(delta_1_rad)
  ziel <- L_ring1 * daten_fuer_spirale$wert[i] / daten_fuer_spirale$wert[1]
  uniroot(function(d) bogenlaenge(a_mitte[i], d) - ziel,
          lower = 1e-6, upper = 4 * pi)$root   # up to two full turns
})

daten_fuer_spirale <- daten_fuer_spirale |>
  mutate(winkel_grad = delta_neu * 180 / pi)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# A2. Function that builds one ring polygon
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
bau_ring <- function(ring_nr, r_start_innen) {
  ring_data <- daten_fuer_spirale |> filter(ring == ring_nr)
  delta_rad <- ring_data$winkel_grad * (pi / 180)

  theta <- seq(0, delta_rad, length.out = 1000)
  w <- (pi / 2) - theta

  r_in <- r_start_innen - k * theta
  r_out <- r_in + dicke

  df <- tibble(
    x_a = r_out * cos(w), y_a = r_out * sin(w),
    x_i = r_in * cos(w),  y_i = r_in * sin(w)
  )

  bind_rows(
    df |> select(x = x_a, y = y_a),
    df |> select(x = x_i, y = y_i) |> slice(n():1)
  ) |> mutate(ring = ring_nr, family = ring_data$family)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# A3. Generate all six rings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
poly_1 <- bau_ring(1, r_start_1 + 0 * dicke)
poly_2 <- bau_ring(2, r_start_1 + 1 * dicke)
poly_3 <- bau_ring(3, r_start_1 + 2 * dicke)
poly_4 <- bau_ring(4, r_start_1 + 3 * dicke)
poly_5 <- bau_ring(5, r_start_1 + 4 * dicke)
poly_6 <- bau_ring(6, r_start_1 + 5 * dicke)

plot_data <- bind_rows(poly_1, poly_2, poly_3, poly_4, poly_5, poly_6)

# ===============================================================
# B. Hatching strokes (pencil look)
# ===============================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# B1. Stroke settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
bg             <- "#faf9f6"   # page colour
deckung        <- 0.85
alpha_strich   <- 0.18
laenge_min     <- 1.0
laenge_max     <- 3.0
strich_dicke_u <- dicke * 0.065
rand_anteil    <- 0.35
n_pkt          <- 8
bild_breite_mm <- 180

set.seed(1900)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# B2. Colours and pigment colours
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
farben <- c("1" = "#D1414D", "2" = "#F6EBD6", "3" = "#F0C34C",
            "4" = "#D9C3A8", "5" = "#C2C8D2", "6" = "#F0C4C4")

papier_rgb  <- col2rgb(bg)[, 1]
farben_rgb  <- col2rgb(farben)
pigment_rgb <- pmin(pmax((farben_rgb - papier_rgb * (1 - deckung)) / deckung, 0), 255)
pigmente <- apply(pigment_rgb, 2, function(x) rgb(x[1], x[2], x[3], maxColorValue = 255))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# B3. Generate strokes for all rings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
ring_info <- daten_fuer_spirale |>
  group_by(ring) |>
  summarise(delta = max(winkel_grad) * pi / 180, .groups = "drop")

mittl_laenge <- dicke * mean(c(laenge_min, laenge_max))
ueberlagerungen <- log(1 - deckung) / log(1 - alpha_strich)

bau_striche <- function(n, r_start_innen, delta) {
  tibble(
    id     = 1:n,
    theta0 = runif(n, 0, delta),
    u0     = ifelse(runif(n) < rand_anteil, rbeta(n, 0.45, 0.45), runif(n)),
    laenge = runif(n, laenge_min, laenge_max) * dicke,
    drift  = rnorm(n, 0, 0.10),
    a      = runif(n, alpha_strich * 0.55, alpha_strich * 1.45)
  ) |>
    crossing(s = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_pkt)) |>
    arrange(id, s) |>
    mutate(
      r_anfang = r_start_innen - k * theta0 + u0 * dicke,
      theta    = theta0 + s * laenge / r_anfang,
      u        = u0 + drift * s,
      r        = r_start_innen - k * theta + u * dicke,
      w        = pi / 2 - theta
    ) |>
    filter(u >= 0, u <= 1, theta <= delta) |>
    transmute(id, a, x = r * cos(w), y = r * sin(w))
}

striche_liste <- list()

for(i in 1:6) {
  r_start_i <- r_start_1 + (i - 1) * dicke
  delta_i   <- ring_info$delta[i]

  flaeche_i  <- dicke * ((r_start_i + dicke / 2) * delta_i - k * delta_i^2 / 2)
  n_strich_i <- round(ueberlagerungen * flaeche_i / (mittl_laenge * strich_dicke_u))

  striche_i <- bau_striche(n_strich_i, r_start_i, delta_i)
  striche_i$ring    <- i
  striche_i$pigment <- pigmente[i]
  striche_liste[[i]] <- striche_i
}

striche <- bind_rows(striche_liste)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# B4. Convert stroke width to line width
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
mm_pro_einheit <- bild_breite_mm / diff(range(plot_data$x))
strich_lw      <- strich_dicke_u * mm_pro_einheit / (.pt * 25.4 / 96)

# ===============================================================
# C. Labels: name on the left ---- line ---- number on the right
# ===============================================================
ring_labels <- daten_fuer_spirale |>
  transmute(
    ring,
    name     = family,
    wert_txt = paste0("$", formatC(wert, format = "d", big.mark = ","))
  )

schrift_size   <- 3.5
x_name_links   <- -3.3
x_zahl_rechts  <- -0.2
abstand_name   <- 0.08
abstand_zahl   <- 0.08
zeichen_korr   <- 1.5
linie_lw       <- 0.2
linie_versatz  <- 0.04

zeichen_breite <- 0.6 * schrift_size * .pt / 72 * 25.4 / mm_pro_einheit * zeichen_korr

ring_labels <- ring_labels |>
  mutate(
    y_pos         = r_start_1 + (ring - 1) * dicke + dicke / 2,
    x_name        = x_name_links,
    x_zahl        = x_zahl_rechts,
    x_linie_start = x_name_links + nchar(name) * zeichen_breite + abstand_name,
    x_linie_ende  = x_zahl_rechts - nchar(wert_txt) * zeichen_breite - abstand_zahl
  )

# ===============================================================
# D. Plot
# ===============================================================
p <- ggplot() +
  # hatching strokes
  geom_path(data = striche,
            aes(x = x, y = y, group = interaction(id, ring), alpha = a, color = pigment),
            linewidth = strich_lw, lineend = "round") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_alpha_identity() +

  # ring outlines
  geom_polygon(data = plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = ring),
               fill = NA, color = "#6B6B6B", linewidth = 0.035) +

  # label lines and start marks
  geom_segment(data = ring_labels,
               aes(x = x_linie_start, xend = x_linie_ende,
                   y = y_pos - linie_versatz, yend = y_pos - linie_versatz),
               color = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = linie_lw) +
  geom_segment(data = tibble(ring = 1:6,
                             y0 = r_start_1 + (ring - 1) * dicke),
               aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = y0, yend = y0 + dicke),
               color = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.15) +

  # label texts: family names (left) and species counts (right)
  geom_text(data = ring_labels,
            aes(x = x_name, y = y_pos, label = name),
            family = "cutive_mono", size = schrift_size,
            color = "#4A4A4A", hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5) +

  geom_text(data = ring_labels,
            aes(x = x_zahl, y = y_pos, label = wert_txt),
            family = "cutive_mono", size = schrift_size,
            color = "#4A4A4A", hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5) +

  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = bg, color = NA))

print(p)
```
